'''''Defensive Stance''''' was the name of a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted a classic [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]] defensive stance.<ref name="SWG" /> The [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text along the right side of the poster read "Teräs Käsi," and according to the lower-left Aurebesh text, the poster depicted a specific move known as a "Nerve Strike."<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Defensive Stance'' was a painting in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

The painting was at first rendered unobtainable after the New Game Enhancements of [[November 15]], [[2005]], but was later included with the Rare Loot System during Hotfix 17.10.
